description: This file implements the AttachSource task for a media pipeline, including classes for building media source capabilities and methods for attaching, updating, and switching media sources in a GStreamer-based media pipeline.

classes.name: MediaSourceCapsBuilder
classes.description: Base class for building media source capabilities, including common attributes and methods for adding alignment, codec data, and stream format to GstCaps.

classes.name: MediaSourceAudioCapsBuilder
classes.description: Derived class for building audio media source capabilities, including handling Opus and MPEG-specific caps.

classes.name: MediaSourceVideoCapsBuilder
classes.description: Derived class for building video media source capabilities, including width and height.

classes.name: MediaSourceVideoDolbyVisionCapsBuilder
classes.description: Derived class for building Dolby Vision video media source capabilities, adding specific caps for Dolby Vision profiles.

classes.name: AttachSource
classes.description: Main class implementing the task to attach, update, or switch media sources in the GStreamer pipeline, managing caps creation and appsrc elements.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the main logic to create caps from the media source and attach or switch the source in the pipeline.

methods.name: addSource
methods.description: Adds a new media source to the pipeline by creating an appsrc element and setting its caps.

methods.name: updateSource
methods.description: Updates the caps of an existing appsrc element if they differ from the new caps.

methods.name: switchAudioSource
methods.description: Handles switching the audio source, including performing codec/channel switch via external utility.

methods.name: createCapsFromMediaSource
methods.description: Creates GstCaps based on the media source type, using specific builders for audio, video, or Dolby Vision sources.

methods.name: createAudioAttributes
methods.description: Constructs audio attributes for switching audio streams, based on the media source's audio configuration.
